Urinal divider screens in the north-west toilets (A-WALL stubs about 0.02 x 0.31 m at y=-33.05, -33.70, -34.35, x -0.17..0.15): fittings, not wall gaps.

method: Worked pictures first: looked at the l30 overview, rendered the whole part once (--grid 1 --inserts, west_full.png), then went over it in 20 zoomed tiles (5 rows x 4 columns, about 6 x 6 m, 0.5 m grid, --inserts: tiles/r1c1..r5c4.png) following every wall line, plus one east context render and two zooms on the toilet cubicles. Every candidate was then confirmed numerically from prims.pkl: top-level A-DOOR block handles / insert points / rotation / frame, leaf and arc lines, nested door families in the central link (D36, D37, D_Swing_Single, Door NO_xx, D_Openning_Lift), the A-WALL end-cap lines on both sides of each gap (a/b are the wall end faces, i.e. frame outer faces, on the wall centre line), and the A-DETL threshold lines the architect drew across most openings. A script paired facing wall end caps to catch gaps with no door block; the free-end list was walked through and every end is either an opening in this list, a corner/T-junction, or in the rejected list. All 14 A-DOOR blocks on the floor and every Parametric_Toilet_stall block were accounted for (3 A-DOOR blocks and the curtain-wall double door lie outside the box). Finally rendered the part with a marker at the centre of every listed opening (west_marked.png) and checked that no door swing, leaf, slider or wall gap was left without a marker. Conventions used: lift landings with no leaf = passage, optional; toilet cubicle doors (leaf drawn) = door, optional, host partition; wall-line gaps leading into stair rooms or an enclosed service room = passage; wide gaps that are just open lobby or corridor ends are rejected or flagged optional.
